verdicts.decision_note: The client authorizes the proposed model build, whose uniquely identified scope retains the financial engine's debt schedule and produces DSCR coverage output.

The source sets the DSCR threshold used to size the availability payment; it does not modify debt-schedule mechanics or DSCR calculation behavior and belongs to the narrower availability-payment sizing Requirement.

missing_event_candidates.description: The client requires availability payments to be sized against a minimum DSCR of approximately 1.65x, alongside the equity-IRR target.
